description: youtube: Trending Shorts. GET /v1/youtube/shorts/trending. Call it with no arguments. Get about 48 trending Shorts per request. Repeated requests can return new Shorts. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
